item.title: Similarities between Bloodborne and Painkiller (2004)
item.description:
I started playing Painkiller: Black Edition recently and took notice of what seems to be deliberate similarities between it and Bloodborne. Posting them here because I find it interesting how what is likely the most unique and beloved FromSoft game was actually inspired by a relatively obscure first-person shooter that was released a little over a decade prior.

1) Every weapon in Painkiller, like in Bloodborne, combines the functionality of two different weapons into one… such as a stake gun combined with a grenade launcher and an SMG combined with a flamethrower. Probably one of the inspirations behind “trick weapon”.

2) One of the first levels in the game takes place in a subterranean civilization reminiscent of Bloodborne’s Pthumeru. There is also an enormous Cathedral similar to the Grand Cathedral in BB. The first level of Painkiller’s “Battle Out of Hell” campaign also has an eery view which seems to have been taken as inspiration for the Fishing Hamlet’s coast in The Old Hunters.

3) Painkiller’s story involves traveling through Hell in order to kill it’s rulers… directly analogous to Bloodborne’s plot of traversing “The Nightmare” to hunt the Great Ones.

item.description:
What should I change? I'm at the end of the game.

For most of the game (This is FFIII) my party was Monk, Black Mage, Red Mage and Viking (initially Warrior.) For most of the game I felt Monk was doing 90% of the work, now as Blackbelt his damage is down because his level's down so I gotta get that back up but Boost is a way better ability so I'm keeping him. BLM also did a fair deal of damage, but similar as Magus is a lower level he's now the weakest member of my party. I'm considering switching him to Summoner or Devout, but I don't know how Summoner compares to BLM in this game.

For a long time Red Mage was the weakest in my party, but at a certain point she overtook the viking and became my default healer, but now that she's a Ninja she's neck and neck in terms of damage with my Blackbelt, so I'm happy to keep her.

On paper Viking has the best stats in my group, but he's by far the slowest and his damage is mediocre, so I'm open to swapping him out as well.
